claims.evidence: Witness photos show a used car engine assembly and related components, but make/model/engine variant and Jeep Wrangler 3.6L compatibility are not readable.
No readable fitment/part-number/vehicle-compatibility markings are shown in the witness report.
No readable drivetrain/transfer-case/low-range markings are shown; photos only show engine/hoses/pipes and bellhousing area.
No documentation, shipping labels, or import proof is shown in the witness report.
Witness report includes visual engine/gearbox end views but no running video, sound recording, compression test, or fault-code readout.
No odometer/ECU mileage readout or service history is shown.
Photos do not show tamper evidence (seal marks, opened fasteners, machining marks) clearly enough to confirm.

risks.risk: Wrong engine/gearbox variant or incompatible fitment for Jeep Wrangler 3.6L 4X4 (or missing required components for that application).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine/transmission identification tags or stamped part numbers (engine block casting/ID plate, transmission model code) plus a photo showing the full included assembly list (starter, alternator, ECU, sensors, injectors, turbo/supercharger if any, wiring harness connectors).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown used engine/assembly with compatibility risk and possible missing parts (worst-case: not guaranteed to fit or be complete).

risks.risk: Not actually tested/working (hidden internal damage, bearing noise, timing/valvetrain issues) despite 'no knock' claim.
risks.proof: A short running video (cold start if possible) with a quick sound check, plus compression test results and/or ECU fault code scan screenshot.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: may need overhaul/repairs).

risks.risk: Incomplete assembly (missing ECU, sensors, injectors, starter/alternator, radiator hoses, wiring harness sections, or transmission components).
risks.proof: A full laid-out inventory photo showing every included part, and close-ups of connectors/ports to confirm nothing critical is missing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case: buyer must source missing parts).

risks.risk: Overheating or prior damage (cracks, warped surfaces, coolant/oil leaks) not visible in the provided angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of critical areas (head/block mating surfaces, oil pan, coolant passages, bellhousing seams) and a leak test/inspection report if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential damage risk (worst-case: may have leaks or structural issues).

risks.risk: Transmission condition unknown (gear wear, clutch/flywheel condition if included, transfer-case issues) even though bellhousing area is visible.
risks.proof: Photos of transmission model code and any included clutch/flywheel/transfer-case components; plus a video of engagement/shift behavior if it can be demonstrated.
risks.if_unproven: Price as transmission condition unverified (worst-case: transmission may require rebuild).

proof_requests: Clear photos of engine and transmission ID plates/stamped codes (engine block casting/ID, transmission model code) to confirm Jeep Wrangler 3.6L 4X4 compatibility.
A running video (ideally cold start) showing it starts and idles smoothly; include a brief sound clip to support 'no knock'.
Compression test results (or equivalent health check) and/or ECU fault code scan screenshot.
Full inventory photos showing every included component (starter, alternator, ECU, sensors, injectors, wiring harness connectors, radiator hoses, and any turbo/supercharger parts if applicable).
Close-up photos of critical surfaces for cracks/warping/leaks (head/block mating, oil pan, coolant passages, bellhousing seams).
Photos of transmission internals/condition indicators (and any included clutch/flywheel/transfer-case parts if present), plus transmission model code.
response.reason: The witness confirms an unknown used engine/gearbox assembly visually, but the key details needed to price it safely (exact make/model/variant, completeness, and verified working condition) are not readable or demonstrated in the report. Without those proof points, any price would be too uncertain.
